description: Header file defining the BufferPool class for managing a pool of Metal buffers in the ANGLE project, including methods for allocation, initialization, and resource management.

classes.name: BufferPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of Metal buffers for dynamic data streaming in the ANGLE project.

methods.name: BufferPool
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the buffer pool, optionally always allocating new buffers.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the buffer pool with context, size, alignment, and max buffer count.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates a region within the buffer pool, possibly creating a new buffer.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Flushes written data to the device to make it visible.

methods.name: releaseInFlightBuffers
methods.description: Releases buffers that are no longer in use.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Immediately frees all resources associated with the buffer pool.

methods.name: setAlwaysAllocateNewBuffer
methods.description: Sets whether to always allocate new buffers on allocation.
